snippet.title: A Home Is Safe - Trailer 2
snippet.description:
COMING OCTOBER 28th, A Home Is Safe is a 3D survival horror game where an old-fashioned firmware update is your only hope of stopping T.O.M, home security robot turned killer. Split your focus between managing a tense computer interface and nerve-wracking first-person survival, rebuilding T.O.M.'s psyche as you evade the imposing threat.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4038910/A_Home_Is_Safe/

Join our Discord to get exclusive early access: https://discord.gg/EGbK7dgnvz
